comment: Throughput baseline for the Benchmarks workflow (see docs/quality.md §5). Regenerate with `scripts/bench_regress.sh --update-baseline` on the CI runner; a baseline recorded on a developer machine is informational only and never gates a build.
recorded_on: developer workstation (Linux x86_64, 16 logical CPUs, concurrent cargo builds running) — NOT a CI runner

reference.source: README.md § Reference numbers (project's own published run: 16-core desktop, 300 MB/round, median of 5)
reference.note: The published figure is ~26 % higher than the measurement above; the measuring machine was busier and used 128 MB/round instead of 300 MB. Absolute numbers are machine-dependent — compare ratios (flux-core vs direct loopback) and trends, not a single value.
